review.note: REVIEW-8.md. PRE-EXISTING confirmed at 1361f1e (Dropdown option onClick without preventDefault, Popover not portalled, labels already at all six sites). Low: a click on list padding in a label-wrapped list still reaches the label (closes the list only).
